enemies.name: Rot Eater
enemies.flavour_text: Part of the Nachzehrer army. The longer they remain on the battlefield, the harder they are to defeat, absorbing the enemy's strength as they grow increasingly deadly.

abilities.text: The more enemies defeated, the higher its HP, ATK, and DEF when spawned from the Twigs That Crave
Releases Corruption, causing your nearby units to continuously lose HP

enemies.name: Sarkaz Witherer
enemies.flavour_text: Part of the Nachzehrer army. Death cannot stop their corrupting presence, as their corpses continue to corrupt the land.

abilities.text: Releases Corruption when defeated, causing your nearby units to continuously lose HP

enemies.name: Sarkaz Witherer Captain
enemies.flavour_text: Elite member of the Nachzehrer army. Death simply causes them to spread their corruption even faster, leaving behind a wasteland where few could survive.

abilities.text: Releases Corruption when defeated, causing your nearby units to continuously lose HP

enemies.name: Sarkaz Wither Caster
enemies.flavour_text: Part of the Nachzehrer army. They are able to heal their kin as they attack the enemy. Life is a constant cycle of devouring and sharing.

abilities.text: Continuously heals the Twigs That Crave

enemies.name: Sarkaz Wither Caster Captain
enemies.flavour_text: Elite member of the Nachzehrer army. Experts at healing their kin as they attack the enemy. Life is a constant cycle of devouring and sharing.

abilities.text: Continuously heals the Twigs That Crave

enemies.name: Seed of Withering
enemies.flavour_text: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. Mindless except for an obsession with self-destruction. They create death for others to feed upon.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Self-destructs when near an Operator, dealing Physical damage

enemies.name: Seed of Decay
enemies.flavour_text: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. It is a violation of the laws of nature, rejecting life for death. They create death for others to feed upon.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Self-destructs when near an Operator, dealing Physical damage

enemies.name: Rotchaser
enemies.flavour_text: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. Fast-moving, they do not understand the concept of healing. They exist only to create death, and the power of healing robs them of their powers.

abilities.text: Attacks cause the target to take Arts damage over time; effect removed when the target is healed

enemies.name: Rampaging Rotchaser
enemies.flavour_text: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. They do not understand the concept of healing, even if they are stopped. They exist only to create death. Thoughts are incompatible with death, and they never stop.

abilities.text: Attacks cause the target to take Arts damage over time; effect removed when the target is healed

enemies.name: Sarkaz Wither Devourer
enemies.flavour_text: Part of the Nachzehrer army. Devours any obstacle in its way, including the living. Anything and everything is food to it.

abilities.text: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker. DEF is greatly increased, but Movement Speed is reduced
Returns devoured Operator when defeated

enemies.name: Sarkaz Wither Maw
enemies.flavour_text: Elite member of the Nachzehrer army. Devours any obstacle in its way, including the living. Anything and everything is food to it. Only death can make it surrender what it devoured.

abilities.text: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker. DEF is greatly increased, but Movement Speed is reduced
Returns devoured Operator when defeated

enemies.name: Sarkaz Wither Tank
enemies.flavour_text: Equipment of the Nachzehrer army, clearing up obstacles for the army's march. It is a powerful siege weapon, but its main role is to spread corruption.

abilities.text: Only attacks ground units
Melee attacks deal more damage
After several attacks, the next attack will release Corruption

enemies.name: Advanced Sarkaz Wither Tank
enemies.flavour_text: Advanced equipment of the Nachzehrer army, clearing up obstacles for the army's march. Its attack power increases at close range. It is a powerful siege weapon, but its main role is to spread corruption.

abilities.text: Only attacks ground units
Melee attacks deal more damage
After several attacks, the next attack will release Corruption

enemies.name: Londinium Mobile Defense Artillery
enemies.flavour_text: Part of Londinium's city defenses. Has a large attack area. Built by the city's workers in their factories.

abilities.text: Capable of long-range attacks
Locks on to the target with the highest max HP and bombards it several times, dealing Arts damage to the unit in range with the highest HP percentage

enemies.name: Londinium Precision Mobile Defense Artillery
enemies.flavour_text: Part of Londinium's city defenses. Has a very large attack area and greatly improved accuracy. Built by the city's workers in their factories.

abilities.text: Capable of long-range attacks
Locks on to the target with the highest max HP and bombards it several times, dealing Arts damage to the unit in range with the highest HP percentage

enemies.name: Steam Tank
enemies.flavour_text: Armored vehicle employing Victorian steam technology, even more dangerous when it has taken damage.

abilities.text: When HP drops to 50%, ASPD and Movement Speed are greatly increased, and becomes immune to most control effects.

enemies.name: Scorching Steam Tank
enemies.flavour_text: Advanced armored vehicle employing Victorian steam technology, even more dangerous when it has taken damage. Virtually unstoppable when it is on a rampage.

abilities.text: When HP drops to 50%, ASPD and Movement Speed are greatly increased, and becomes immune to most control effects.

enemies.name: Sarkaz Royal Court Caster
enemies.flavour_text: A caster of the Sarkaz Royal Court. Sarkaz witchcraft is often more dangerous in battle than war machines. They boast a distinctly Sarkaz fighting style, but with greater discipline.

abilities.text: Attacks deal additional Necrosis
Locks on to your units, dealing continuous Arts damage, and causing area Necrosis when casting is complete

enemies.name: Sarkaz Royal Court Elite Caster
enemies.flavour_text: An elite caster of the Sarkaz Royal Court. Sarkaz witchcraft is often more dangerous in battle than war machines. Their skill and discipline are second to none.

abilities.text: Attacks deal additional Necrosis
Locks on to your units, dealing continuous Arts damage, and causing area Necrosis when casting is complete

enemies.name: Theresis
enemies.flavour_text: Regent Theresis of Kazdel has gathered the Sarkaz army at Londinium and occupied The Shard. If total war is to be avoided, he must be stopped from declaring war on the dukes.

abilities.text: Cannot be attacked, will not deplete Life Points on leaving the field
Knocks down anything in its way

enemies.name: 'The Last Steam Knight'
enemies.flavour_text: Steam Knights are the pride of Victoria, her fist, her highest military honor. The last Steam Knight rises from sealed ruins, intent on defending the Victoria in his heart.

abilities.text: Debut Phase
ATK and Movement Speed are reduced, but restored once [Pneumatic Pressurization] is triggered
First Form
[Pneumatic Pressurization] Gains increased ATK and Movement Speed and becomes immune to control effects; stuns self when effect expires
[Furious Defense] Charges up before attacking, dealing heavy damage 3 times

[Unto My Last Breath] Leaps into the air after losing a certain amount of HP, targeting your unit with highest max HP and dealing multiple Arts damage hits to the nearby unit with the highest HP percentage
Second Form
Has reduced DEF and RES
[Pneumatic Pressurization] becomes permanently active
[Unto My Last Breath] locks onto an additional target
